notes: SBLGNT.MAT.4.24.v012 selects r00-base and every token of it is realized.

*with* at t021 is given to the dative νόσοις as the realization of its case (rules 21, 106's oblique arm), leaving συνεχομένους a bare *holden*; the coordinate βασάνοις takes no repeated preposition, the ASV writing none.
Heading δαιμονιζομένους on *possessed* rather than *demons* remains defensible; the root-glossing word is chosen under rule 66's denominal clause, as ἱκανώσαντι → *made meet* heads on *meet*.
κακῶς ἔχοντας is split, the ASV writing two English words rather than collapsing the pair into a single verb (rules 2, 73); joining them on *were sick* remains defensible.
τοὺς takes the single relativizer *that*, which is pronoun and relativizer at once (rule 90).
